text:
Omar: Hey team — tiny PSA: I opened the office cereal drawer this morning and half a box of my MapleCrunch (blue lid, label 'OMAR') is gone. Left a sad soggy bowl in the sink. Not mad but pls check before you 'help yourself' :sweat_smile:
Julia: oh noooo that is tragic :sob: who even steals breakfast cereal
Matt: I have no shame. If it was chocolate-flavored it was probably me. Will replace.
Sheri: Label maker to the rescue — I left extra label strips in the drawer next to the tape. Also we should put a note on the fridge: "DO NOT EAT \u2014 PERSONAL"
Omar: thanks Sheri — also small thing about the espresso machine: if you use the steam wand, please purge after each use. It was gurgly this morning.
Kofi: noted on espresso. I can do a quick clean tonight. Also volunteer to replace cereal if Matt can't.
snackbot: Reminder: Kitchen rota updated. This week coffee duty: Kofi. Snack stock checks: Friday morning.
Julia: poll — what milk should we restock? Reply with emoji: :oat: Oat, :almond: Almond, :cow: Regular
Matt: :oat: (I vote oat, saves me)
Omar: :almond: (but willing to buy whatever)
Sheri: :oat:
Kofi: :oat:
Matt: I'm headed to TJ at 11:15. Want me to pick up MapleCrunch replacement + oat milk + a new box of tea bags? I'll grab receipt and leave on top of the fridge. Venmo me for cereal: @mattj.
Omar: Legend. If you can, please also grab a 2" roll of clear tape and the 1" label strips.
Matt: will do. Also putting this down as very official instruction: Do Not Eat Other People's Snacks. It should probably be laminated and stuck on the pantry door.
Julia: can we get a tiny laminated 'no snack thievery' sign? I can make one real quick and stick it with command strips.
Sheri: Also posting a quick fridge etiquette reminder in #general later. Keep it friendly, not shaming.
Omar: appreciated. Last note: I used a marker and wrote this on the cereal box: ```OMAR — DO NOT EAT — 3/23``` in case thieves are illiterate.
Kofi: thanks Omar. I'll steam-clean the wand tonight and double-check the grinder dosing.
Matt: Bought everything. Left receipt + change in top of fridge. Replaced cereal. Photo: <https://imgur.com/fakepic123> :tada:
Julia: thanks Matt!! :partyparrot: Everyone please check your things and label if needed.
